current_status.question: Are you experiencing chest discomfort or pain right at this moment?

breathing_difficulty.question: Are you also having any shortness of breath or difficulty breathing?

severity.question: On a scale of 1 to 10 (where 1 is mild and 10 is unbearable), how would you describe the discomfort?

onset.question: Approximately when did this chest discomfort begin?

breathing_difficulty_present.question: Are you having difficulty breathing right now?

can_speak_full_sentences.question: Can you comfortably speak in full sentences without needing to pause for breath?
options: No, need to pause / struggling to talk

onset.question: Did this breathing difficulty come on suddenly or gradually over several hours/days?

severity.question: How severe is your breathing difficulty currently?

stiff_neck_or_confusion.question: Do you have any stiff neck, unusual confusion, extreme dizziness, or sensitivity to light?

duration_days.question: How many days have you had this fever?

temperature_reported.question: Have you measured your body temperature? If so, what was the reading?

rash_present.question: Have you noticed any new skin rash or purple/red spots?

severe_deformity_or_bleeding.question: Is there any visible bone deformity, deep open wound, or uncontrolled bleeding?

can_bear_weight.question: If an arm or leg was injured, are you able to bear weight, walk, or move the injured limb?

numbness_or_loss_of_pulse.question: Do you feel numbness, tingling, or coldness past the site of the injury?

location.question: Which specific body area was injured?

vomiting_blood_or_rigid_abdomen.question: Is your stomach hard like a wooden board, or have you vomited blood or noticed black stool?

is_worsening.question: Is the abdominal pain progressively getting worse over time?

location.question: Where is the pain located primarily?

severity_score.question: How intense is the pain on a scale from 1 (mild) to 10 (severe)?
